steps.content: You've been here constantly lately, preparing the venue. You know every corner intimately.
But the strange part is that the simulation's scene doesn't match the real gallery. It's an exact copy of your prepared setup.
At first, you assumed the gallery staff helped reconstruct it. But with each entry into the simulation, the feeling grows: something is wrong.
Every scene in this simulation is a location where you once faced the phantom thieves!
